copy.headline: CONCACAF W tourney taking over TX Nov. 27-Dec. 5; USWNT to play at least 2 games
copy.caption: Texas Health Mansfield Stadium has been gifted the actual goals used during World Cup matches at Dallas Stadium in Arlington, giving the city a unique piece of soccer history.
